title: Modern Workspace
summary: A visual-system rebuild gives the BOM Command Deck a cleaner hierarchy, true light and dark modes, quieter surfaces, better typography, consistent outline icons and more usable page layouts without changing the underlying tools.

sections.title: New visual system
items: Rebuilt the dashboard around a restrained warm-neutral design system instead of near-black surfaces and overlapping gold glow treatments.
Added true Light and Dark appearance modes with a persisted account preference and pre-paint theme bootstrap to reduce theme flashing.
Adopted Inter for interface copy and Space Grotesk for display typography through an open-source font source, with robust system fallbacks.
Normalized navigation and utility icon styling around an open-source Lucide-style outline language without adding a runtime icon dependency.

sections.title: Navigation and layout
items: Redesigned the desktop sidebar, active navigation, account area and collapse control for clearer grouping and less visual noise.
Simplified the top bar and moved desktop Quick Create into the top bar; the floating action is now reserved for mobile where it is useful.
Reduced oversized page heroes and standardized page widths, spacing, borders, controls and card hierarchy across dashboard tools.
Refined the command palette into a calmer action/search surface with readable recent items and a two-column action launcher.

sections.title: Dashboard, Wiki and Map
items: Reduced the Dashboard hero footprint and balanced the session, Music, Sentinel, recents, favorites and attention sections.
Reworked Wiki visual hierarchy so natural-language search is the primary action while the article directory reads more like an encyclopedia.
Refined Map controls, layer presentation and canvas framing; map terminology now consistently says Map rather than Chart.
Updated popovers, notifications, inspectors, tables, forms, empty states and modals to use the same shared visual language.

sections.title: Admin, Sentinel and responsive UI
items: Refined Basic, Advanced and Diagnostics administration views without changing their save or API behavior.
Improved Sentinel table, filter and health surfaces for clearer operator scanning.
Reworked responsive behavior so the desktop navigation collapses cleanly and mobile keeps the Command Dock and a compact Quick Create action.
Kept focus states, reduced-motion support, table virtualization hints and existing accessibility behavior intact.
